overview_description.description:
With Meetings.io you can meet face to face with anyone from around the world within your web browser. Meet with a client, a customer, your project team or your co-workers in person without ever leaving your desk by simply creating a tiny meeting room link and sharing the link with anyone you want to meet with.

You can re-use your meeting room as many times as you want and you can have people drop in and out of the your room anytime. Because there's no sign ups or user registration needed to drop into a meeting room you can use Meetings.io as an online hangout for real time in person hangouts or as a telepresence system to attend meetings remotely.

about_short_description.short_description: Meetings.io provides a group video conferencing and hangout service that allows users to meet with anyone by creating a meeting room link.

product.name: Meetings.io Meeting Platform
product.description: A cloud-based platform for organizing and conducting group video meetings with collaborative agenda and note-taking features.

product.name: Collaborative Meeting Tools
product.description: Features that enable real-time collaboration during meetings, including live note-taking, shared agendas, and task management.

product.name: Meeting Agenda Management
product.description: A system to create, customize, and collaboratively manage meeting agendas with sections for topics, KPIs, tasks, goals, and wrap-ups.

product.name: Meeting Timer
product.description: A built-in timer to allocate and monitor time for each agenda section to keep meetings on schedule.

product.name: Meeting Notes and Summaries
product.description: A tool for taking live meeting notes and sending organized meeting summaries to participants and stakeholders.

product.name: Celebration Feature
product.description: An option to trigger visual celebrations like fireworks or applause when team members achieve goals or complete tasks during meetings.
